summary: Contadino of Guardia Lombardi, husband of Grazia Di Marino and father of John Petriello; John's 3rd-great-grandfather.
bio:
Pietro Petriello, also written Petrillo, was born about 1837 at Guardia Lombardi, Avellino, Campania, Italy, a son of Angelo Petriello and Lucia Marra; a son's 1869 birth record, giving his age as 33, points to about 1836, and his death record to about 1837. He was a contadino, a peasant farm labourer. His sister Gaetana married Giuseppantonio Lucadamo in 1855.

He married Grazia Di Marino, born about 1845, the daughter of Gaetano di Marino and Caterina di Leo, probably between 1863 and 1868; an indexed Avellino civil record naming the couple together with her parents is very likely their marriage act. Their children included John Petriello, John's 2nd-great-grandfather, and Filomena, born in the neighbouring town of Carife on 16 December 1885, which places the family there that year.

Pietro died at his home on Via Piazza in Guardia Lombardi on 29 March 1901, aged 64, described as a contadino born in Guardia and the husband of Grazia Di Marino. The death was reported by Francesco De Biasi, aged 72, a sign of how close the Petriello and Di Biase families were.

researchNotes:
Tree: Pietro Petrillo/Petriello + Grazia Di Marino (b. 1837). Son's 1869 birth act: Pietro Petriello fu Angelo, 33, contadino (so born c.1836). Death act: died 29 Mar 1901, Guardia (Via Piazza), aged 64 (so born c.1837), contadino, born in Guardia; son of the late Angelo and the late Lucia Marra; 'marito di Di Marino Grazia'; Morti 1901 act 28; the declarant was Francesco De Biasi, 72 (showing the families were close). Round 2 had this as probable from the FS tree (sourced to Avellino civil registers, FS records 6PG6-674L and 6PG6-674V). The FS tree also gives him an impossible wife 'Grazia Sasso, 1796-1848' - ignore. His sister Gaetana Petriello married Giuseppantonio Lucadamo in 1855. The marriage of Pietro and Grazia was not found: Guardia marriage indexes for 1855-61, 1863, 1865 (part) and 1866-68 were checked; 1862 and 1864 registers are not on Antenati. Grazia was born c.1845, so the marriage was probably c.1863-68 (1862, 1864 or a missed page of 1865).

Three FamilySearch-indexed Avellino civil records are attached to Pietro's tree profile ([R4-S1]). The first (ark 1:1:6PG6-674L) indexes Pietro together with Grazia di Marino (6PG6-674V) and her parents Gaetano di Marino (6PG6-674K) and Caterina di Leo (6PG6-6742), all under one record. That pattern is typical of a marriage act, so it is very likely the Petriello–Di Marino marriage that Round 3 could not find in the Antenati indexes. The second (6PJX-KPGJ, with Angelo Petriello, Lucia Marra and Grazia) is his 1901 death act, already read. The third is the 16 Dec 1885 birth of daughter Filomena at Carife (QPR6-CHPY), which places Pietro and Grazia in neighbouring Carife in 1885. The images are blocked from here, so the record date of 6PG6-674L is unknown.
